name: Bishoujo Ikenai Hatsutaiken
original_name: 美少女いけない初体験
source:
Main character stays at his aunt's house for the 3rd year. He calls a female cousin Saki to tutor him and soon falls under her influence and gets treated as a servant. Protagonist is going to lose virginity with his classmate Karin at birthday party. But Saki opposes the idea greatly and at creates obstructions at every step.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在姨妈家住了第三年。他请一位表妹咲来辅导他，很快就受到她的影响，并被当作仆人对待。主角将在生日聚会上与同学卡琳失去童贞。但咲极力反对，并处处设置障碍。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
